_extra.definitions: Measured from the three-quarter drawing by volume/prep/fit.mjs: 2D landmarks (characters/<id>.json threeQuarterFront.joints with volume.threeQuarterFront.jointOverrides) + one depth prior per joint, at view angle 45 deg under core/camera project(). pelvisHeight = thigh + shin + ankleHeight (straight legs); pelvisHeight + spine + chestLen + neck + headLen = height. hand = wrist -> fingertips. Limb lengths are the mean of the two drawn sides.
